summary: The new orbit file re-declares Mathlib's `UpperHalfPlane.I_re` and re-derives the ρ-inversion identities that TauCeti's own `Rho.lean` (imported here, otherwise unused) and the file's own `stabilizer_ρ` lemmas already give; the ρ real-part and corner facts are stated twice in this PR and a third time in `ValencePV.lean`, and `canonicalReps` carries a conjunct implied by its neighbour.
